title: MORSIQO: a menu you turn like a table
summary: A fire-kitchen restaurant site where the menu turns like a table: dish-by-dish detail with pairings, then a build-your-table order sent straight to the kitchen.
alt: MORSIQO website: a round table of plated dishes with the headline “Burrata, blood orange”.

title: ReelOrbit: step inside the show
summary: Movie ticket booking across Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and Hindi, with a draggable 3D poster carousel and seats picked inside a 3D hall.
alt: ReelOrbit website: a curved 3D carousel of film posters with KGF Chapter 2 in focus and a Book tickets button.

title: Stadiora Park: pick your seat in 3D
summary: A match-day seat picker set in a 3D stadium and park: hover a stand to check seats, click to fly in and drag to orbit the ground.
alt: Stadiora Park website: a 3D stadium in a green park with floodlights, seen from above.

title: Viara Studios: where architecture becomes home
summary: A scroll-built story site for a luxury residential developer, with a signature-residence showcase, a filterable home finder and an EMI calculator.
alt: Viara Studios website hero: a construction site at dusk with the headline “Every legacy begins with ground.”

title: ATHLEX: a performance club built to show up
summary: A bold, high-energy site for a Bengaluru strength and performance club, covering programs, trainers, memberships and one-tap free-trial booking.
alt: ATHLEX website hero: a gym with dumbbell racks and the headline “Build your strongest self.”
